item.title: Closing Your Solar Business? Outstanding Job Obligations
item.description: Most of what you will find written about a solar installer closing down is written for the homeowner who has already been left stranded. It tells them how to chase a warranty on a business that no longer answers the phone, how to find a new installer, and where to complain. Useful for them. Useless for you, the operator sitting at the kitchen table at ten at night wondering whether you can actually afford to keep the doors open another quarter.
